description: Read one page by id or slug. Read-only. Returns { found: true } with id, name, slug, published, pageType, parentId, the draft blocks and layoutBlocks, customFields, displayName/seoTitle/seoDescription per language, seoKeywords, version (pass it as expectedVersion to patch_block_content), createdAt and updatedAt - or { found: false, idOrSlug }. To find a page, use list_pages or search_content.

idOrSlug.description: The page's id or slug (from list_pages or search_content)

target.description: 'draft' (default) returns the shared page draft. 'devDraft' additionally returns YOUR per-user dev draft overlay in `devDraft` (null when you have none).

name: get_page
title: Get page
